paite: Na lak ua zawlnei hiam, mangnimi ham ahongom a, chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak a,
chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak, ahong tangtun a, na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte zui ni e, a-nna uh sem ni," na kiang ua achihleh;

huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam thute na ngaikhe ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na hinna tengteng un na it uhia, itlou chih theihtelna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian un ahon ze-et ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh na zui ding ua, amah laudan na siam ding ua, athupiakte na zui ding ua, athugente na zui ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua, amah na len tinten ding uh ahi,

Huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam hihlup ding ahi. Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan hon tanpa TOUPA na Pathian un zuih ding thu ahon piak lampi a pan hon pialsak dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung a helna thu agen ziak in, huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.

Na unaupa, na nu tapa hiam, na tapa hiam, na tanu hiam, na zi pom lai hiam, na lawm nangmah hinna bang hial nangawn in leng, ahon zol a, kisa ni, "pathian dangte nna sem ni," ahon chihleh; nang hiam, na pipute hiam in leng na theih louh uh pathiante;
na kimvel ua, na kiangchin ua omte hiam, na kigamlatpih deuh uhiam, kawlmong a pan kawlmong khat lam pha a mite pathiante;
pha na sakpih ding uh ahi kei, amah na ngaikhe ding uh ahi sam kei. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, na hawi ding uh leng ahi sam kei, na iim ding uh leng ahi sam kei hi.
Na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi zaw. That ding in khut na kha masa ding a, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in akhut uh akha ding uh.
Suang a na denlup ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian ua kipan hon pialsakna ding azon ziak in.
Huchi in Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, na lak ua huchibang tatsiatna himhim achingta kei ding uhi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na tenna ding ua ahon piak na khua khat a na lak ua kipan Belial tate khenkhat hong pawt a,
huai khopi a mite na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte be ding in apimang uh," chih thu kigen na zak uleh kan unla;
dingkhia unla, phatuamngaitak in dongkhia un. Ngai un, thudik ana hih a, huchibang thilkihhuai na lak ua hih ahi, chih theihtel ahihleh,
namsau a huai khua a tengte na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Asung a om tengteng, ganhonte toh namsau in na hihmangthang vek ding uh ahi.
Gallak thil teng kholak ah na lakhawm ding ua, khua leh gallak thil teng TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah halmang thillat in na hal ding ua, leivui lel ahi tawntung ding a, lam thak ahi nawn kei ding hi.
Gallak thil bangmah na khoih ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA'N aheh mahmahna akiheisan dia, zahngaihna ahon musak ding a, hon hehpih ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih hih dia tua ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh nou ahon pungsak ding hi; na pi-le-pute uh kiang a ana kichiam khit bang in.
